basis: Representative window11r production pair; preparation interval inferred from scope/ref file mtimes, gates use receipt timestamps. Serial work sum is not observed end-to-end latency.

immediate.shared_worktree_gates: serial, with tracked candidate writes quiesced
immediate.future_batch_sizes: 20-40 mechanics or60-80shortentries, bounded by same source identity, actual preflight and evidence budget; no retroactive merges of frozen tasks
immediate.B_selection: risk-selected neutral worksets may start with A; add uncovered A-observation units only via a new neutral frozen selection
immediate.writer: one EXECUTOR per repair window; drain affected baseline reviews before target writes

maintenance_required.bulk_prepare: single invocation, one immutable inherited-history replay, validate every task selection/current candidate/coverage binding and final full replay; no gate-receipt reuse or cross-command cache
maintenance_required.isolated_workers: first two real worktrees/workspaces for gate concurrency, after root-map/native/predecessor/task/gate identity and publication support is implemented and independently reviewed
maintenance_required.production_wave_limit: existing tools support changes=[] only; nonempty integration apply requires verified implementation before use

validation.pilot: three source-comparable future batches; report actual end-to-end units/hour plus prep/model/gate/retry durations
validation.target: at least2x observed throughput as an acceptance objective, not a measured claim
